how_picked: H1 pick (2026 Jan-Jun, win % >= 50, plateau score)
rules: LIT exactly as live (engine/lit.py, live_model.json 'lit': inducement first, 5m CISD, limit 30 min, 1m CISD entry, stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme, VIX-band target, 15-minute check, BE + 1.25 pts, Monday rule, weekly stop), but entries only in London open 02:00-05:00, 1 trade a day.
This window's own thresholds: sweep >= 0.75 ATR deep, displacement body >= 0.6 ATR, target banked at 8.0R, breakeven at 1.0R.
Flat 15:55 ET at the latest (an evening entry is held at most to 15:55 of its trading day).
costs: $1.40 a micro round trip + 1 tick on market entries, stop and time exits (eval views $1.90)
data: TradingView CME NQ1! 5m (data/NQ_5m.csv), 1m for the 2026 trade path (data/NQ_1m.csv)
